verdict.rationale: Headless or CI operation is a fair question for an authentication tool, since a buyer could reasonably ask whether codes can be generated programmatically. The evidence, however, describes only an interactive mobile app that relies on QR scanning, tap-to-approve, biometrics and PIN. It documents no CLI, API or headless mode, and the probes found no OpenAPI or machine-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
